categories.main_business_segments: Nanshan Aluminium International Holdings Limited is principally engaged in the production and sale of metallurgical-grade alumina, including aluminium hydroxide. The company operates alumina production projects in Indonesia with a focus on refining alumina as a raw material for electrolytic aluminium production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced digital management systems and an advanced Distributed Control System (DCS) in its production process, enabling real-time monitoring and adjustment of operations. It emphasizes technological innovation, cost control, and logistics efficiency in alumina refining, with production facilities located in a Special Economic Zone in Indonesia.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are in Southeast Asia, including Malaysia, Hong Kong, Singapore, Indonesia, and South Korea, with products used mainly in the electrolytic aluminium industry. The alumina produced serves downstream industries such as construction, transportation, electrical, and packaging sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Southeast Asia, with principal production facilities in the Galang Batang Special Economic Zone, Bintan Island, Indonesia. Its sales markets include Malaysia, Hong Kong, Singapore, Indonesia, South Korea, and previously Mainland China and Switzerland.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanshan Aluminium operates in the midstream segment of the aluminium supply chain, focusing on alumina refining from raw materials such as bauxite and coal, supplying metallurgical-grade alumina to downstream aluminium producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes capacity expansion, technological innovation, and cost efficiency. It is constructing a new alumina production project to double capacity and invests in ESG initiatives and talent development. The company also focuses on intellectual property management and digital production process optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of metallurgical-grade alumina products, priced via formula-based contracts referencing market indices and spot trading through bidding processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanshan Aluminium is positioned as a leading alumina producer in Southeast Asia with industry-leading cost advantages and technological strengths. It competes with other regional alumina producers such as Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately US$1.02 billion in 2024, a 50.6% increase from 2023, with a profit of US$457.4 million, up 163%. It has expanded production capacity to two million tons annually with plans to increase to four million tons, reflecting strong growth and financial stability with no borrowings.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanshan Aluminium emphasizes high product quality exceeding national standards, cost leadership through resource integration and logistics advantages, and sustainable development. Its advanced digital control systems and strong supply chain partnerships provide reliable, high-performance alumina products tailored to customer needs.
